name: trustlens
description: TrustLens — catch phishing & impersonation in SMS, email and QR codes (English, Kannada, Kanglish). Runs fully offline.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && node scripts/check-offline.js
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run start -w server
